description.value:
Maximum HP +8 and outgoing healing +2. Record actual HP restored by your healing. The next allied attack adds half that amount as damage, capped at +4; consume the record. One trigger per turn, latest healing replaces the record.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching abundance Path required.
